newsitem.title: USA: Texas/w Okla feedlot cattle market inactive - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Texas/w Okla feedlot cattle market inactive - USDA.

text.p: Trade was inactive in the Panhandle area early Monday, USDA said.

Slaughter steers and heifers not tested. Feedlots reporting moderate inquiry from buyers. There were 2,800 head confirmed for the week to date. The last established price was $67.00 on Friday. Monday's packer bids were $66.00-$67.00, with asking prices $68.00-$69.00.
Note - all cattle prices based on net weights FOB the feedlot after a 4 percent shrink.
